gateway: isolated temporary home, approval=reads; a freshly seeded gateway for the stub screenshots, one for the live ones and one for the walkthrough
data: fictional, seeded through the app's HTTP API (capture/scenes.json)

agent_backend.stub: Kiro Crew's offline stub ACP backend (capture/stub_backend.py) for every other scene; no chat reply is shown from it
agent_backend.credit_reading: the browser answers the top bar's credit readout (/api/sessions/usage) with "no reading", so no account balance or email can be shown

note: The isolated gateway served the Create Folders From Project app built into the Kiro Crew checkout (src/kiro_crew/apps/builtins/project_scaffolder, website/src/apps/project-scaffolder), because a gateway that still ships the built-in cannot install a second app under the same name. This repository is the externally packaged copy of that page, ported with the same markup, strings and requests; PORTING.md lists where the two differ, and none of the differences is on screen in these pictures.
data_notes: The app scans a directory on disk and has no API that writes one, so capture/demo_tree.py wrote a made-up workspace (an allotment-planner project for a community garden, with two small git repositories inside it) under the system temp directory, and the gateway ran with HOME pointing at the made-up home folder beside it.
The sidebar folders in the results picture were created by pressing the page's own Create sidebar folders button.
